original_local_details: The original source supplies the local problems and frozen public readings. Exact local serials, roles, supervised exterior matches and bounded text below are disclosed new candidates. No private family sketch text, rescue key, hidden detention location or main evidence is supplied.

paragraphs.en: One local junction sign is being replaced. ROLE-R5-REED-RESIDENT recalls Reed Lane, and the different ROLE-R5-LANTERN-RESIDENT uses Lantern Turn for present visitors. Hear both at the keeper's local consultation before selecting a name. Neither group is required to abandon its memory. The two current workshop sample boards, R5-SIGN-REED-01 and R5-SIGN-LANTERN-01, are alternatives for this one installation; the unused board stays in the workshop.
paragraphs.zh: 只换一个地方街口的牌。ROLE-R5-REED-RESIDENT 记得 Reed Lane，另一 ROLE-R5-LANTERN-RESIDENT 为当下访客用 Lantern Turn。先在保管人地方询议位听到两方，再选名称；不强迫任一方放弃记忆。工坊 R5-SIGN-REED-01、R5-SIGN-LANTERN-01 是同一安装的两个替代样板，未用板留在工坊。

paragraphs.en: Choose Reed Lane with the second line Also called Lantern Turn, or Lantern Turn with the second line Formerly called Reed Lane. Either proposal must name ROLE-R5-SIGN-CREW as the existing local maintainer and retain both consultation references. At the sign stand, inspect the selected physical board, fit that same board to the single local junction and check both visible lines. A prepared sentence is not an installed sign. The checked installation changes this small public marker only; it does not change an old map, a property record or a legal route.
paragraphs.zh: 可选 Reed Lane 配 Also called Lantern Turn，或 Lantern Turn 配 Formerly called Reed Lane。两方案都指定既有 ROLE-R5-SIGN-CREW 维护并保留两方询议来源。在路牌位核选中实物板，把同板实际装到一个街口，检查两行可见字。句子写好不等于牌已装，只改变局部公共标识，不改旧地图、产权或通行法定规则。

paragraphs.en: Save the proposal at the proposal stand, confirm its intended name, other remembered name, consultation and maintenance scope explicitly, and return to the keeper for the read-only delivery preview. The proposal and the physical check must refer to the same current board. Closing the preview does not install another sign or award resources. The once-only local acceptance keeps the unused board, original public reading and both memories; no main or ending condition is awarded.
paragraphs.zh: 在提案位保存正文，明确确认选名、另一记忆名、询议及维护边界，再回保管人看只读交付预览。正文与实物检查须指同一当前板。关预览不多装牌、不发资源。一次本地接受保留未用板、原公开阅读和双方记忆，不发主线或结局条件。

paragraphs.en: ROLE-R5-PROPERTY-KEEPER holds two distinct local objects: brass pot R5-POT-01 and wrapped family memento R5-SKETCH-01. The supervised public pot description is repaired_left_handle and maker stamp BR-7. ROLE-R5-POT-CLAIMANT supplies that same description; a claim of an intact right handle or another stamp remains uncertain. Inspect the actual pot and compare both fields under a current object_identity_and_recipient scope. That scope does not permit opening the other family's wrapped sketch.
paragraphs.zh: ROLE-R5-PROPERTY-KEEPER 保管两件不同地方物：黄铜锅 R5-POT-01、包裹家庭纪念物 R5-SKETCH-01。受监督公开锅描述是 repaired_left_handle、制作者印 BR-7；ROLE-R5-POT-CLAIMANT 给出同描述。完好右柄或另一印记的认领保持不确定。按当前 object_identity_and_recipient 范围核同锅两字段，不准打开另家包裹速写。

paragraphs.en: The wrapped memento was locally tagged unverified_private_association, not accepted into the genuine responsibility archive. Keep that original tag in the correction history. The public exterior identifies R5-SKETCH-01, sealed wrapper WR-19 and the separate owner referral WIT-R5-SKETCH-TITLE-01 for ROLE-R5-SKETCH-OWNER. Ask the keeper to obtain that owner's specific wrapper_identity_and_title permission, inspect the same sealed exterior, and check the referral. Those checks establish local custody for this returned object; they do not prove a historical crime, and the actual core evidence remains untouched.
paragraphs.zh: 包裹纪念物曾被地方标为 unverified_private_association，没有成为真实责任档案的已接受证据。纠正历史保留原标签。公开外观指 R5-SKETCH-01、封装 WR-19，另有 ROLE-R5-SKETCH-OWNER 的 WIT-R5-SKETCH-TITLE-01 归属引介。请保管人向主人取得限定 wrapper_identity_and_title 许可，核同一封装外观和引介。只确认本件归还保管，不证明历史犯罪，不动真正核心证据。

paragraphs.en: No family drawing or private accompanying letter is supplied in this candidate. Reading or publishing its contents remains unavailable, even when exterior custody is checked. The owner can withdraw the wrapper check permission before the final local acceptance, which invalidates older approvals and previews. An already recorded physical return stays with its actual recipient; withdrawing a check does not duplicate or remotely recover that object. Return the same pot to ROLE-R5-POT-CLAIMANT and the same sealed memento to ROLE-R5-SKETCH-OWNER, never a second copy for another claimant. Correct the local association to private_memento_not_case_evidence while retaining the original tag and current custody receipts.
paragraphs.zh: 候选不提供家庭画面或私人附信；外观保管核对后，内容阅读公开仍不可用。主人可在最终地方接收前撤回外观核验许可，使旧审批预览失效。已经实际归还的原物保持当前接收人保管；撤回核查不复制或远程收回该物。原同锅归 ROLE-R5-POT-CLAIMANT，同封装纪念物归 ROLE-R5-SKETCH-OWNER，不给第二认领者复制。地方关联纠正为 private_memento_not_case_evidence，同时保留原标签和当前保管回执。

paragraphs.en: At the claim desk, save a bounded note identifying both serials, permitted recipients, the separate uncertain-claim outcome and the correction's limits. Confirm that meaning explicitly and take the read-only handover preview to the keeper. A local release awards no experience, marks, parts, rescue access, six-tower resource or ending qualification. If custody cannot be verified, leave the object with the keeper rather than turn uncertainty into an accusation.
paragraphs.zh: 在认领桌保存受限便条，指两序号、获准接收人、独立的不确定认领处理及纠正边界。明确意思后把只读交接预览带保管人。地方放行不发经验、刻币、零件、救援准入、六塔物资或结局资格；归属不能核清就留给保管人，不把不确定变指控。
